description: tests/common/mod.rs highlight() uses lower_needle.len() (byte count of lowercase needle) to slice into the original haystack. For Unicode chars where to_lowercase() changes the byte count (e.g. Ω U+2126 is 3 bytes but lowercases to ω U+03C9 which is 2 bytes), the slice &haystack[abs..abs+lower_needle.len()] cuts at a non-char-boundary and panics. Reproducer: highlight("Ω", "ω"). This is test code only, but panics abort the test process rather than failing gracefully.
title: highlight() panics on Unicode chars with different lowercase byte width
